title: Running time for binary length
statement: The finite Turing machine computes, on every finite input word $x$ over its symbol alphabet, the binary expansion of the length of $x$ in time $5(|x|+1)$, where the binary expansion is represented by the list of binary digits returned by the natural-number bit function.
hypotheses_covered: For every input word over the machine's symbol alphabet
The output is the list of binary digits of the input length
The time bound is $5(n+1)$ for input length $n$
